semiconductor_relevance: High — Hitachi High-Tech specializes in metrology and inspection equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hitachi High-Tech provides advanced metrology and inspection equipment for semiconductor devices, including solutions for SiC power devices and RF communication devices.
